interactions.description: Increased risk of bleeding. Aspirin inhibits platelet function and may potentiate the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid concurrent use unless specifically indicated. Monitor INR closely if combination is necessary.

interactions.description: NSAIDs increase the risk of GI bleeding and may enhance the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.
interactions.recommendation: Use acetaminophen as an alternative analgesic. If NSAID required, use lowest dose for shortest duration.

interactions.description: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP1A2, potentially increasing warfarin levels and bleeding risk.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor INR frequently. Consider dose reduction of warfarin during antibiotic therapy.

interactions.description: Omeprazole may increase warfarin levels via CYP2C19 inhibition.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor INR when starting or stopping omeprazole. Consider pantoprazole as alternative.

interactions.description: Combined use may increase the risk of hypoglycemia.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose levels closely. Adjust doses as needed.

interactions.description: Common therapeutic combination. May cause excessive blood pressure reduction.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure, especially when initiating combination. Often used intentionally.

interactions.description: Risk of serotonin syndrome. Both drugs increase serotonergic activity.
interactions.recommendation: AVOID combination. If necessary, start with low doses and monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia).

interactions.description: High risk of serotonin syndrome. Fluoxetine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor that also blocks serotonin reuptake.
interactions.recommendation: CONTRAINDICATED. Use alternative analgesic. If unavoidable, requires close monitoring in hospital setting.

interactions.description: Amlodipine increases simvastatin levels, raising the risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis.
interactions.recommendation: Limit simvastatin dose to 20mg daily when combined with amlodipine.

interactions.description: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia increases the risk of digoxin toxicity.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor potassium levels and digoxin serum concentrations. Supplement potassium as needed.

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce renal clearance of lithium, potentially causing lithium toxicity.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid NSAIDs. Use acetaminophen instead. If NSAID necessary, monitor lithium levels closely.

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors reduce lithium excretion, increasing risk of lithium toxicity.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor lithium levels frequently. Consider dose reduction. Use alternative antihypertensive if possible.

interactions.description: Combined negative chronotropic and inotropic effects may cause excessive bradycardia or hypotension.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure. Often used together therapeutically with appropriate monitoring.

interactions.description: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19, reducing the antiplatelet effect of clopidogrel.
interactions.recommendation: Use pantoprazole instead of omeprazole. Avoid other CYP2C19 inhibitors.

interactions.description: Increased risk of tendon rupture, especially Achilles tendon, with concurrent fluoroquinolone and corticosteroid use.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination if possible. If used together, advise patient about tendon symptoms.

interactions.description: SSRIs impair platelet function. Combined with aspirin, increases GI bleeding risk.
interactions.recommendation: Consider gastroprotective agent (PPI) if combination is necessary.

interactions.description: Combined CNS depression. Risk of respiratory depression, profound sedation, coma, and death.
interactions.recommendation: AVOID combination. If absolutely necessary, use lowest effective doses and shortest duration.

interactions.description: Ciprofloxacin may cause dysglycemia (both hypo- and hyperglycemia) when combined with antidiabetic agents.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose closely during antibiotic therapy.

interactions.description: PPIs reduce gastric acidity needed for levothyroxine absorption.
interactions.recommendation: Take levothyroxine on empty stomach, at least 4 hours before omeprazole. Monitor TSH levels.

interactions.description: Generally no significant interaction. Minimal clinical significance.
interactions.recommendation: No dose adjustment required. Standard monitoring.
